Problem Statement:
Write a Java program to swap two numbers without using a third variable. 
Input Description:
The program should accept two integers A and B as input. 
Output Description:
The program should print the values of A and B after swapping. 
Sample Input:
2
3 
Sample Output:
Before swap: 2 3
After swap: 3 2
